about_pullquote: We turn up on time, do the job right, and charge a fair price.
about_para_1: Adis Plumbing and Handyman Services has been serving Sheffield for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many families waiting hours for a plumber, or getting hit with inflated bills. Since then, we've built a reputation for showing up fast, fixing problems properly, and treating every customer's home with respect.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we don't oversell unnecessary work, and we stand behind every job. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned bathroom refit, you'll get the same friendly, professional approach. We're locals who care about Sheffield, and it shows.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Families Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe on a Sunday morning. Called Adis and they were here within 45 minutes. Fixed it properly, cleaned up after themselves, and the price was fair. Brilliant service—will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Can't fault them. Fitted a new bathroom three months ago and the workmanship is excellent. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished on time. No messy follow-up calls or hidden extras.
reviews.author: Lisa K.

reviews.text: Called for a leaking tap repair that I thought would be straightforward. Graham spotted a deeper issue with the pipes and explained it clearly without pressuring me. Fixed it all in one visit. Honest and skilled—recommend them to everyone.
reviews.author: David S.
